title: An email to a player, version 1
description: The one file content/email/boiler_reminder.json (work order 039). 'subject' and each of 'lines' may hold {tinker}, the Tinker's name. 'button' is the link back to the game. 'opt_out' says why the email came and how to stop it, and 'opt_out_link' is the one-click link's words; both are required, so no email can ship without them. Word limits and banned words are the style check's; the reveal check reads the file as act 0. The shape is fixed by the engine's loader, so the file takes no other field, 'revision' included: its register row's revision is null.
